name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2025-06-03, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
